content.caption:
This project will help you learn and build foundation.

1. AI Resume Analyzer
Paste your resume + a job description and get a match score, missing keywords, and rewritten bullet points using an LLM.
Tech: Python, OpenAI API / Gemini API, Streamlit

2. Face Recognition Attendance System
Detect and recognize faces from a webcam feed to mark attendance automatically no manual entries needed.
Tech: Python, OpenCV, face_recognition, Flask

3. AI Chatbot with NLP
Build a chatbot that understands user intent using NLP and responds with contextual replies deployable as a web app.
Tech: Python, NLTK / spaCy, Flask, HTML/CSS

4. RAG-based Document Q&A Bot
Upload any PDF and ask questions about it the app chunks, embeds, and retrieves context before answering with an LLM.
Tech: Python, LangChain, FAISS, OpenAI API, Streamlit

5. Object Detection App
Use a pre-trained YOLO model to detect objects in images or live video add a Streamlit UI to make it shareable.
Tech: Python, YOLOv8, OpenCV, Streamlit
